candidates.title: Edge0 releases Edge0-145B / 120B: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-derived latent MoE (10B active) trained natively at 4-bit, runs on one 24GB consumer GPU, claims 86.5 Terminal-Bench 2.1

Below threshold.
